power.method: 24 VAC, or PoE (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30 W, heater not powered) / 60 W midspan NPD-6001B (heater powered); redundant supply supported

storage.notes: Full-size SD card slot up to 2 TB (microSD adapters not recommended)

features: Open camera platform (Security & Safety Things application store)
Starlight imaging, 120 dB HDR (100 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Pan 360 deg continuous, tilt 18 deg above horizon
Turbo mode pan up to 400 deg/s, tilt up to 300 deg/s
ONVIF Profile S, G and T
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDP_7602_Z30_Data_sheet_enUS_84741871883.pdf). Clear-bubble outdoor pendant model. Sensitivity at 30 IRE (F1.6, 1/30). Operating temperature -40 to 55 C with heater wired (-10 to 55 C without). Consumption 51 W typical with heaters (19.2 W heaters off). max_fps taken from the datasheet bitrate table (30 fps).

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
